page: Microsoft Azure E128ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family memory-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 64 physical cores and 128 vCPUs enabled via Hyper-Threading. The CPU configuration includes a 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. High-speed local storage is provided via a bundled 7559 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

Benchmark data indicates a contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. The instance achieves top-tier status in multi-core metrics, including a stress-ng multi-core score of 144593.74 and a PassMark CPU score of 132394.2. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the average tier at 2282.07. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching top-tier speeds of 655.3 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 253.51 GB/sec for large-block write operations. Database operations also rank in the top tier, with Redis SET operations reaching 209.67 million operations per second. For LLM inference workloads, prompt processing speeds rank in the strong tier, whereas text generation speeds fall into the average tier.

Given the high resource density of 1024.0 GB RAM paired with 128 vCPUs and a large 7.5 TB local NVMe SSD, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive memory footprints and high-speed local storage without the overhead of external disk arrays. The inclusion of advanced instruction sets, such as Intel Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions, enhances its efficiency for vector and matrix calculations. This server is suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics pipelines, and heavy multi-threaded enterprise applications.
